I.A.No.29836 of 2021 for change of counsel is allowed.
The Registry to reflect the name of new counsel by deleting the name of earlier counsel in the cause list.
Heard on I.A. No.29043 of 2021.

This is the first application seeking for suspension of sentence and bail filed on behalf of accused Lalaram Ahirwar who has been convicted under Sections 376(3), 363, 366(a) of Indian Penal Code and sentenced to 20 years RI, 03 years RI, 05 years RI and fine of Rs.2,000/-, Rs.500/- and Rs.1000/- respectively with default stipulations vide impugned judgment dated 11.02.2020 passed by the First Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO), Ganjbasoda, District Vidisha in Session Trial No.56 of 2018.

entities.text: First Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge (POCSO), Ganjbasoda, District Vidisha
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The case of the prosecution is that on 03.08.2018 at around 17.00 hours, father of the accused (PW/3) came to police station Gulabganj and reported about his missing minor daughter (PW/2).
Missing Person Report No.14 of 2018 (Ex.P/6) and on the basis of said report, a complaint was recorded by the Head Constable, Police station Gulabganj.
On the basis of said report, the police has registered Crime No.146 of 2018 under Section 363 of the IPC.
After necessary investigation charge sheet was filed against the appellant.
He was put t o trial.
After trial, the Trial Court convicted and sentenced the accused as indicated hereinabove.

Learned counsel for appellant while taking exception to the impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence submits that the Sessions Court has not appreciated the evidence placed on record in correct perspective.
The judgment suffers from surmises and conjectures.
He has falsely been implicated in the instant case.

Learned counsel further submits that the direct involvement of the Lalaram Ahirwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102734933/
1 appellant in commission of the aforesaid offence is not reflected.

sentences.text: There are contradictions and omissions in the statements of the material witnesses.
The learned Trial Court has committed an error in convicting and sentencing appellant for the alleged offence.
There is no likelihood of early hearing of the appeal in near future.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
Per contra, State counsel has vehemently opposed the contentions so made by counsel for the appellant stating that there is sufficient material available on record against the present appellant.
There is active participation of the appellant in the commission of alleged offence.

On these grounds,
he has prayed for dismissal of the application.
Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and looking to the active participation of the present appellant in commission of alleged offence, no case for grant of bail is made out.
Accordingly, I.A. No.29043 of 2021 is hereby rejected.
